question: Do masked, dual-view, or geometry-aware inputs improve development nutrient regression over a same-environment original-image baseline?

data.test_access_policy: Do not read test images or labels during 005 execution

pretrained.decoder: fine-tuned mask decoder without external prompts, selected Part A method

preprocessing.masked_rgb: preserve predicted foreground RGB exactly; replace background with RGB 128
preprocessing.clip: pad to square with CLIP mean color, resize to 224x224, CLIP normalization
preprocessing.feature_normalization: fit mean and standard deviation independently per input block on train only; add 1e-6 to standard deviation
preprocessing.target_normalization: divide all five targets by train-set target means
preprocessing.geometry_components: 8-connected components on the predicted binary mask

training.selection: minimum dev normalized nutrient MAE epoch per seed

models.B2: original 512 -> 64 ReLU and masked 512 -> 64 ReLU; concatenate -> dropout -> 5 Softplus; 66309 parameters
models.B3: B2 128 fused values plus 8 standardized geometry values -> dropout -> 5 Softplus; 66349 parameters

metrics.primary: mean across energy/protein/carbohydrate/fat MAE divided by train means
metrics.secondary: MAE for mass g, energy kcal, protein g, carbohydrate g, fat g
metrics.uncertainty: 1000 paired bootstrap draws of dev plate groups, seed 0; negative candidate-minus-baseline favors candidate

environment.execution_target: Google Colab Pro with an NVIDIA GPU
environment.exact_runtime_record: capture before data/model execution in Drive environment.json
environment.torch: Colab CUDA build, exact version recorded and unchanged across B0-B3
environment.hardware: Exact assigned GPU, CPU, RAM and disk captured before execution
environment.comparability: All B0-B3 conditions execute in the same captured Colab runtime; historical B scores are context only

time_budget.segmentation_gpu: up to 4 hours; resume-safe per-image artifacts; actual duration recorded
